subject: general
question: Town X is west of town Y. Town Q is north of X. Town P is east of Q and north-west of Y. What is the position of town P with respect to X?
solution:
Given:

Town X is west of town Y.

 Town Q is north of X.

Town P is east of Q and north-west of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a88457cb41fb99906d9528932ff77199671788fd08b754c87397b7c240aabc9.png] 

Thus, Town P is north-east of Town X.

Hence, the correct answer is** " Option 3".**
